objective: Prepare one RWO-rooted, C19-gated execution surface for the DomainSpec L0 Rule construction DAG.
claim_ceiling: This plan prepares an implementation candidate only. It does not activate routing, execute a DAG node, accept a binding, admit a system ontology, publish, release, deploy, or authorize an external effect.
invariants: Exactly one RWO root scheduler owns structural release for the stream.
C19 emits no-effect decisions and never schedules work.
Every mutable work node is dominated by an exact successful C19 gate and an unchanged authorization envelope.
The nine C19 stages remain ordered and exact.
Every dependent node is represented as pending, blocked, not_evaluable, succeeded, or failed.
Exactly one native helper authors and self-validates a new exact implementation-binding candidate; the parent joins and closes it.

tasks.title: Freeze exact orchestration preimage
tasks.done_when: Every selected input has an exact identity and unrelated dirty bytes are excluded.

tasks.title: Resolve composition ownership
tasks.done_when: The outcome is proven to be a composition of owned capabilities or is stopped for a new-capability decision.

tasks.title: Freeze selected D65 dependency manifest
outputs: Exact definitions, capability decisions, ontology selectors, DomainSpec sources, compiler/runtime bindings, and evidence identities
tasks.done_when: Every applicable D65 stage has an exact selected predecessor or a causal open gate.

tasks.title: Define composite interface contracts
tasks.done_when: Authority, effect, identity, failure, and replay fields are closed and non-inflating.

tasks.title: Create successor L0 stage map
outputs: Singular governance stage per work node
tasks.done_when: Every L0 node has one ordered location and no implementation precedes its exact binding gate.

tasks.title: Specify L0-to-RWO compiler
tasks.done_when: The specification yields one finite acyclic bounded graph with one root scheduler.

tasks.title: Specify C19 gate adapter
tasks.done_when: Only dual-permission exact-stage CONTINUE maps to success and every other result emits no work.

tasks.title: Specify repository work adapter
tasks.done_when: The adapter cannot execute outside the selected root, scope, toolchain, deadline, or effect ceiling.

tasks.title: Specify accepted-history and resume contract
tasks.done_when: One accepted-history authority can reconstruct the exact structural cursor without becoming domain authority.

tasks.title: Prepare hostile-first test matrix
outputs: Cycle, missing dependency, gate bypass, stage mismatch, digest drift, path escape, scope expansion, event reuse, retry exhaustion, deadline, and helper-receipt mutants
tasks.done_when: Every invariant has a named positive witness and exact-cause killed mutant.

tasks.title: Obtain exact bounded implementation authorization
outputs: Exact files, effects, helper contract, toolchains, deadline, and stop conditions
tasks.done_when: The owner authorizes one bounded repository-local reversible implementation attempt.
tasks.claim_limit: Planning completion does not satisfy this gate.

tasks.title: Author exact composition binding with one native helper
tasks.done_when: One helper authors and self-validates the exact candidate; parent joins, closes, and freezes its postimage.

tasks.title: Validate offline no-effect composite graph
outputs: Determinism, schema, hostile, gate-domination, replay, and authority-ceiling results
tasks.done_when: All offline L0 composition checks pass without issuing repository work.

tasks.title: Execute one read-only preflight node
tasks.done_when: The real result matches direct execution and no repository byte changes.

tasks.title: Review exact mutation packet
outputs: Frozen graph, implementation postimage, read-only evidence, exact mutation scope, rollback, and requested decision
tasks.done_when: The exact owner authorizes the bounded mutable L0 attempt.

tasks.title: Run controlled L0 construction
tasks.done_when: The graph reaches its terminal structural posture without scope expansion or first-effect failure.

tasks.title: Freeze terminal L0 packet
outputs: Immutable source, graph, binding, execution, evidence, residue, rollback, owner, and challenge identities
tasks.done_when: Every task is represented and the packet requests at most one exact terminal decision.
